conbody.p: Baselines lists the project's baselines as a timeline, newest first, with the Working copy, the project as it is now, at the top. Select a baseline to compare from it; it is marked from, and what it is compared to is marked to. Choose what to compare to under Compare to: the working copy or another baseline.

The comparison counts the artifacts added, changed and removed, and lists every change with the fields that changed. Text only narrows the list to changes of title or text, and Links to links added or removed.

Select a change to read its text word by word: removed words are struck out in red and added words underlined in green. When you compare to the working copy, the links of that artifact that are suspect now are named under it. Open the full comparison opens the comparison page with every link.
